instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Mount FastAPI backend endpoints in `backend/routers/rfq.py` for `/api/rfq` POST and GET, storing inquiries into MongoDB collection `rfqs` with auto-timestamping.
2. Seed initial realistic RFQ records in `backend/seed.py` for testing and demonstration.
3. Set up the frontend UI using Tailwind v4 in `frontend/src/index.css` with `@import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk';` and `@import '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans';`.

4. Implement all key sections matching the requested sequence: 1) Positioning Hero with EST 2007 ticker, 2) Institutional Credibility Strip, 3) Procurement Capability Matrix, 4) 8 Core Capability Groups with interactive drawers, 5) 8 Industries Served, 6) 6-Step How Midas Works Process Timeline, 7) Selected Clients & Experience Monochrome Wordmark Wall + RFQ Conversion Strip, 8) Multidisciplinary Project Showcase, 9) Quality & HSE Philosophy, 10) Full Contact Details & Direct Inquiry Form.
5. Provide an interactive RFQ / Quote Request modal that seamlessly submits to `/api/rfq` and displays instant confirmation with sonner toast notification.

6. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have clear `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid='hero-rfq-btn'`, `data-testid='conversion-strip-rfq-btn'`, `data-testid='rfq-modal-submit-btn'`).
7. Include a live RFQ Management / Admin drawer or view allowing the team to inspect submitted inquiries and test end-to-end B2B lead capture functionality.

anti_patterns: No generic centered templates or bootstrap cards
No light purple AI gradients (#7351B7 is strictly forbidden)
No stock handshakes or fake call center photos
No missing contrast: text must maintain high legibility against dark slate surfaces
pro_patterns: Precision technical typography with monospace badges & coordinates
Monochrome client logo wordmarks that smoothly tint on hover
High density of actionable procurement data and clear RFQ/BOQ pathways
Generous spacing: p-8/p-12 with 1px dark slate borders and vibrant safety orange CTAs
